rule: The plan for a prompt keeps, in this order, every file and every block whose versions list the prompt version and whose when conditions all hold for the prompt. A when condition names a prompt fact and its required value: shape, the product-layout.json phase2 shape the prompt selects; healthz, whether the resource or parent path is /healthz (naming.json W2); auth, storage and workflow, the prompt capabilities of those names. A when value that is an array lists the values the fact may take. when stays in the catalog: a DSL block has only id, name, params and refs. A block param {"$ref": "a.b"} names the prompt value at /a/b. refs name blocks of the same file. A file path names the prompt value in braces. Every block id starts with rust. and is rendered by the Rust block library. A prompt outside the phase 1 profile keeps the plan of its version: rust.lib.modules renders the hand-written migrator (naming.json W3) when the phase 1 profile refuses the prompt it renders for.
